Job Description: 
 Job Title: Database Admin/Documentum Developer 
 Location: Washington, DC Metro Area 
 
 Job Description: 
 Responsibilities 
 · Ensure the effective use of Client resources 
 · Expert knowledge of the SQL environment with emphasis on planning, analysis, design and implementation of reports and report interfaces intended for the end user 
 · Contribute to long-term strategic planning 
 Supplemental Duties: 
 · Minimum 3-5 years or more of progressive experience with Documentum. 
 · Experience with Oracle databases and SQL servers 
 · Experience in high availability, load balancing and tuning 
 · Experience with Documentum 7.1 is a plus 
 · Understanding of metadata concepts and the integration with external interfaces 
 

 **  Please share me your updated word copy of Resume. 

 *** I Appreciate, if you can  refer  someone who is looking for this position. 
 Contact  703 291 0984
